description: This file implements core server daemon operations for the Ansc Daemon Server TCP object, including engaging, canceling, starting, and stopping the server and its associated engines. It contains functions for socket setup, binding, listening, and clean shutdown procedures.

classes.name: ANSC_DAEMON_SERVER_TCP_OBJECT
classes.description: Main object managing the TCP server daemon, including socket management, engine control, mode settings, and threading.

classes.name: ANSC_DSTO_WORKER_OBJECT
classes.description: Worker object responsible for managing server tasks during engage and cancel operations.

classes.name: ANSC_DAEMON_ENGINE_TCP_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents individual engine instances that handle specific server functionality and are started/stopped as part of the server operation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDstoEngage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Engages the server, setting up sockets, binding, listening, initializing engines, and spawning the accept task.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDstoCancel(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cancels the server operation, shuts down sockets, stops engines, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDstoStartEngines(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Starts all engine instances associated with the server object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDstoStopEngines(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Stops all engine instances associated with the server object.
